The '''Sabas Killik Queen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] who was the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of [[Sabas]], a Killik nest that emerged from hibernation in the [[Kaamos Territory]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. Making her nest on a small island in the [[Pestilence Pond]], she was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]] and her head taken as a trophy.
